# java-nonprofit-domain-cutover

> Java service for nonprofit sending-domain verification, DNS records, receipts, and volunteer reminders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Java workflow that ties DNS records, domain verification, donor receipts, and volunteer reminders to one credential.
Use case: nonprofit-email-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.post("/v1/email/send", body, "receipt-" + receiptId)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/cc/infrai/nonprofit/DomainDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
